# Financial Services Regulatory Corpus

> **Generated file. Do not edit it by hand.** The source of record is [`specs/fsi/`](../specs/fsi/). Regenerate with `make fsi-render`. CI fails if this file drifts from the corpus.

Recordkeeping and auditability obligations for regulated financial workloads, with the controls that implement them on AWS. Every period stated here is quoted verbatim from the primary source it cites. Each record carries a confidence level, the date it was verified, and a date by which it must be re-verified. Once that date passes, the build fails. This is engineering reference material, not legal advice.

Machine-readable export: [`specs/fsi/export/corpus.json`](../specs/fsi/export/corpus.json). Example: `jq '[.obligations[] | select(.retention.period_months) | {id, months: .retention.period_months}] | sort_by(-.months)' specs/fsi/export/corpus.json`.

## How to read confidence

| Level | Meaning |
|---|---|
| high | The current primary text was read, and every quoted number was compared against it verbatim. |
| medium | The primary text was read, but either its currency is unconfirmed (for example the original Official Journal text rather than the consolidated version) or the record is design guidance rather than law. |
| low | Allowed for instruments only, and none currently carry it. Unmigrated references have not been read, so they carry no confidence level at all. |

| 6 years | — | [Account-opening records kept six years after the account closes](regulations/us.md#us-sec-17a-4-c) | Members, brokers and dealers subject to Rule 17a-3 | 17 CFR 240.17a-4(c) |
